title: Topic
description: One topic: the commander's own statements on a single subject, each held verbatim with the transcript it came from, so the pilot can see how his thinking on that subject stands. Filed by name, altitude.json.

kind.description: the word topic, which is what chooses this schema

id.description: the topic's name in lowercase with hyphens, the same name the file is named for; a topic carries a name, not an identifier

title.description: the topic in a few words, as a reader would look for it

scope.description: what belongs in this topic and what does not, in one line

record.description: the manual this topic has been distilled into, by file name; absent until one exists

updated.description: the date a statement was last added, YYYY-MM-DD

statements.description: one row per statement: where it came from, when, the commander's words, and what was happening around them

ref.description: where the statement can be found again, as session and line, 9b679556:7004

date.description: the day it was said, YYYY-MM-DD

statement.description: the commander's own words, verbatim and never edited

context.description: what was happening when he said it

superseded_by.description: the ref of the later statement that overrides this one; absent while it stands
